children: Overview
Hong Kong pork producer's half-year revenue rose 3.3% on higher packaged meat sales
Operating profit fell 2.2% due to weak hog production in Europe and China
Net income attributable to owners rose 6.6% year-over-year
Outlook
WH Group targets construction of its New Sioux Falls Facility from H1 2027, with production due by end-2028 and investment of up to $1.3 bln
WH Group expects to complete its acquisition of Nathan's Famous for $102 per share in cash in H2 2026, subject to shareholder and CFIUS approval
Result Drivers
PACKAGED-MEAT GROWTH – Revenue rose 6.9% as China expanded emerging channels and customers, while Wolf Group added European sales and premium products
PORK PROFIT PRESSURE – Pork operating profit fell 31.0%, as low hog prices and animal diseases hurt China and lower prices plus higher costs squeezed Europe

The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 11 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and 1 "sell" or "strong sell"

Wall Street's median 12-month price target for WH Group Limited is HK$11.00, about 39% above its August 27 closing price of HK$7.92
The stock recently traded at 8 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 10 three months ago
